div.b:
NON-TECHNICAL: Like a report card with different subjects (Math, English, etc.). Each subject has different importance (weight).
Your final grade = (Math grade × 40%) + (English grade × 25%) + (Science × 20%) + (Art × 15%).
TECHNICAL: Weighted linear combination of normalized metrics. Allows balancing multiple objectives with configurable priorities.
Formula: reward = Σ(metric_i × weight_i) where Σweight_i = 1.0
